component.name: LeePanel
component.summary: Agentless Linux server management over SSH

description.p: This is a community package of LeePanel, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.

LeePanel is a desktop control panel for Linux servers. Instead of installing a panel on the server, it runs every operation as an SSH command from your own machine — no agent, no extra port, nothing left behind on the server.

ul.li: SSH terminal and SFTP file browser with upload, download and archive handling
Web stack management: Nginx sites, PHP, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis
Docker containers, images and compose projects
Firewall rules, ports and free SSL certificates
Live system monitor: CPU, memory, disk, network and top processes

description.p: Servers, credentials and settings are stored in this package's own sandboxed data directory (~/.var/app/com.leepanel.desktop). Of your real home, only ~/Downloads is available by default, which is where SFTP transfers can read and write.
A few optional capabilities are not granted by default; enable the ones you need with "flatpak override":

ul.li: Log in with an existing SSH private key from your host: flatpak override --user --filesystem=~/.ssh:ro com.leepanel.desktop
Transfer files anywhere in your home instead of just ~/Downloads: flatpak override --user --filesystem=home com.leepanel.desktop

description.p: LeePanel's built-in self-updater cannot replace a Flatpak install. New upstream releases are picked up by FlatPark and delivered through "flatpak update" instead.
